title: Egg drop soup with tofu
skill: Holding a simmer while the egg goes in

notes.text: Pour the eggs in two batches, stirring between them.

move.title: Ribbons in a simmer
move.body: Egg drop soup is a Chinese home soup made in minutes: hot broth, a little cornstarch to thicken it, and beaten egg poured in slowly so it sets into soft ribbons. Today you'll hold the pot at a gentle simmer while the egg goes in.

why.title: Cornstarch in cold water first
why.body: Cornstarch makes lumps in hot broth. Stirred into cold water first, it mixes in smoothly and thickens the soup.

why.title: Hold a gentle simmer
why.body: Small bubbles cook the egg into soft ribbons. A hard boil breaks the egg into tiny bits.

why.title: Pour slowly
why.body: A thin stream of egg, poured while you stir slowly, makes long, thin ribbons.

why.title: The egg sets fast
why.body: Egg sets in hot broth in a few seconds. When the ribbons are white and yellow with no runny egg, they're done.

wrong.fix: The cornstarch went in without water. Whisk hard to break the lumps.

wrong.sign: The egg is in tiny bits
wrong.fix: The soup was boiling or stirred fast. Keep it at a gentle simmer next time.
Add a little more soy sauce, a few drops at a time.

quiz.q: Why mix cornstarch with cold water first?
How do you pour the egg?
choices: In a thin stream while stirring slowly

quiz.q: What happens if the soup boils hard?
choices: The egg breaks into tiny bits
quiz.explain: Keep it at a gentle simmer.

steps.text: Pour the broth into the pot. Stir in the ginger and soy sauce.
Bring it to a boil over high heat.
Pat the tofu dry with a paper towel. Cut it into small cubes with the butter knife.
steps.look: Cubes about the size of dice.

steps.text: Stir the cornstarch and cold water in the small bowl with the fork.
Crack the eggs into the medium bowl.
steps.tip: Fish out any shell with a bigger piece of shell.

steps.text: Wash your hands with soap, and throw away the shells.
Beat the eggs with the fork until there are no streaks.
Turn the heat down to medium-low. Add the tofu.
steps.look: Small bubbles just breaking the top.

steps.text: Stir the cornstarch again. Pour it in while you stir the soup.
steps.look: The soup turns a little thicker and shiny.

steps.text: Stir the soup slowly in a circle. Pour in the egg in a thin stream.
steps.tip: Pour from just above the pot, not from high up.

steps.text: Wait 30 seconds. The egg ribbons should be set, with no runny egg.

target.look: Soft, set ribbons of egg, no runny egg

steps.text: Turn off the stove. Slice the green onions thin.
Stir in the sesame oil and pepper. Ladle it into bowls and top with green onion.
steps.look: Yellow ribbons and white tofu in a golden soup.
